{# Admin-authored updates, shown ONLY to signed-in slips as a small dismissible pop-up. Replaces the old front-page "Updates" section. The content is fetched from /updates.json (empty for anonymous visitors), so base.html stays cheap on every page and the pop-up appears site-wide, not just on the front page. Dismissal is per-update in localStorage, so a viewer who closed an update never sees it again and is never nagged. Theme-aware: --sc-* surfaces, text inherited. #}
